scope: Public es-MX-oriented Spanish lexical catalogue with English definitions, source-level provenance, and qualified regional evidence.

entity_types.description: Versioned Spanish written lexical entry distinguished by its source and entry key; multiple parts of speech and etymologies are not silently merged.
An individual English-defined meaning belonging to one lexical entry, with sense-level usage labels, examples and attestations.
Source-attested grammatical or morphological variant associated with a lexical entry.
A named edition/extraction and its retained attribution and reuse conditions.
A sourced region-specific label on an individual sense; missing labels have unknown regional status.
Separately sourced evidence that a surface word was observed in a bounded regional corpus, not a guarantee about the word's meaning or universal usage.
Versioned, sharded corpus release with integrity metadata, counts, provenance, and language pair.
Generated website index or consumer export derived from corpus records, not an independent source of lexical facts.

invariants: Mexico-specific labels attach to senses only when explicitly supported by source data.
Absence of a Mexico label does not establish non-use in Mexico.
Regional frequency evidence and Mexico-labeled meanings are different claims.
Published lexical material retains Wiktionary-derived CC BY-SA and GFDL obligations.
Stable review-history reconciliation across different upstream versions is not assumed.
Site browsing and consumer exports contain no personal learning history.
